decisions.structure: CSharp LlvmIrGenerator supplies BoundProgram, target/platform and library mode to LlvmEmitter; Emit/WriteProgram/GenerateUnits select memory, writer or keyed units. LlvmCodegenUnit retains exact identity and interface/implementation keys; MemoryOutputSink preserves ordered text/insertion segments before CopyTo. Native CodegenUnits/StreamedUnit retain the corresponding prefix/module/suffix identity, keys, fragments and borrowed owner lifetime.
decisions.branches: Plain versus writer versus reuse-aware emission; shared prefix/module/shared suffix; exact identity ordering under hash ties; text versus insertion segments; valid framed/keyed units versus malformed/incomplete/order/limit rejection. Native emitted control and ownership providers supply already committed IR to the output consumer.
decisions.logic: This is the downstream compiler-output consumer boundary included by the frozen CodeGen source scopes. It adds no new expression/control/ownership algorithm to wrappers or sinks. Native text unit framing and CSharp managed segmented storage are representation adapters, not equal byte formats or identical allocation strategies. Generated program Console I/O is a separate runtime component.
decisions.diagnostics: Preserve platform capability admission, complete identity/key checks, sink self-copy rejection and Native unit framing failures. No output sink fallback, source scope narrowing or claim of all output/insertion/caching behavior is introduced.

decisions.structure: CSharp reusable semantic functions retain stable function identities and formatted canonical binding types, then LlvmIrGenerator consumes the materialized BoundProgram. Native module_artifact_types captures declaration/type details, encodes ordered reachable recipes and rebinds them to the current type arena; production scoped specialization naming consumes captureTypeDetailsAnalyzed and encodeRootOrderedRecipes.
decisions.branches: Exact declaration and product field labels; selected roots/dependencies versus unrelated sentinels; valid recipe restore versus failed decode/rebind/materialization. module_artifacts separately stores complete source identity bytes with schema/length/checksum and rejects changed source-local ordinals before decode.
decisions.logic: Compare stable input identity and current type materialization responsibilities, not CSharp LLVM-fragment cache bytes with Native TypedIR words. The observed production consumer is scoped_declarations.prepareGenericSpecializations. Whole-IR encodeExact/decodeExact is a separate API: no current production whole-IR cache caller was established by the source inspection. Its presence and role are registered without inventing a production path or new roundtrip execution.
decisions.diagnostics: Keep all existing status/error propagation and exact source/structural dependency guards. Invalid recipes and source identities do not become arbitrary current-session TypeIds. Complete serializer equivalence, all roundtrip branches and end-to-end cache acceptance remain separate.

decisions.structure: CSharp BoundStreamJoin/statement plans retain source order, input types, policy, terminal and callback/drop ownership. Native StreamPlan retains pipelines, stages, junction inputs and partition routes and is consumed both by ownership_check interpolation facts and context_prepare/codegen; function scheduling recognizes planned terminals before ordinary structured iteration.
decisions.branches: Range/Stream/EventStream/single source, named producer aliases, ordered transform stages, zip/concat/merge/latest and partition route terminal association. Both CSharp RequiresConcurrentJoinRuntime and Native stream junction dispatch consume the shared NativeRuntimePolicy worker decision.
decisions.logic: The source link is the common typed continuation-plan input and downstream consumer boundary. Preserve callback/source ordering and owner type information; do not reinterpret every stage as an eager ordinary call. Stream runtime callbacks, bounded worker lifecycle and all event timing remain downstream responsibilities with their own acceptance.
decisions.diagnostics: Existing invalid pipeline, source/receiver/type and owner constraints remain. No newly executed stream runtime or complete family acceptance is claimed from the named dependency or current general58 regression evidence.

decisions.structure: CSharp SollangLibraryManifest.Load validates the target sidecar and supplies typed native FunctionDeclarations consumed by normal calls. LlvmEmitter.Library produces the fixed scalar synchronous effect-free export interface and forwards its public ABI through the internal runtime-context prefix. Native projectLibraries projects validated library metadata into typed call/result/parameter/binding/read nodes and synthetic native functions, then existing library_exports emits the matching export boundary.
decisions.branches: Target/interface/ABI admission; Unit/scalar result and primary/additional inputs; no-effect export with no captured/generic/block/async state; unresolved projection, arity and argument type diagnostic versus a validated call. Preserve direct fixed-scalar ABI while the internal context prefix uses the generated shared policy.
decisions.logic: Library.cs is the interface producer, not the CSharp import resolver. The actual CSharp import counterpart is SollangLibraryManifest plus normal Native/FunctionCalls; Native imports are direct metadata-to-IR projection rather than generated Sollang source. This records the actual producer/consumer contract without conflating those operations or expanding the accepted ABI.
decisions.diagnostics: Preserve missing/invalid/wrong-target interface, export capability, unknown projected call, argument count/type checks and source spans. No new imported-library execution, complete scalar catalog, runtime policy or platform acceptance is asserted.
